title: 第17章 还望师兄指点一二第18章 我就随口瞎掰了几句啊
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
【叮！
投喂师妹羊肉串，领域范围增加一厘米！
【叮！
投喂师妹羊肉串，领域范围增加一厘米！
【叮！
投喂师妹羊肉串，领域范围增加一厘米！
小院之中。
林清瑶每吃一串羊肉串，陆鸣的脑海就会响起系统的声音。
不得不说林清瑶是很能吃的。
陆鸣做的羊肉串有着堪比上品丹药的效果。
林清瑶完全是放开了吃，左右手各拿一根羊肉串，吃的脸颊微涨，好似仓鼠似得。
陆鸣见林清瑶吃的飞快，心里也乐呵。
毕竟一串羊肉串就能增加一厘米的领域范围。
如果可以，她真希望林清瑶能一刻不停的吃下去。
两人很快将羊肉串一扫而空，陆鸣可算是解了馋，这三年来鸡肉吃的够够的了。
相比之下，还是羊肉串好吃。
收拾完竹签子，陆鸣对林清瑶道：“好了，饭也吃完了，师妹你抓紧时间修炼吧。”
“是！
师兄！”
林清瑶干劲十足，她也想着赶快习练一下这个《青霄蕴灵诀》。

毕竟先前玄辉真人可是说这功法乃是上乘功法威力不俗。
现在她修为虽然已经是筑基六重，但迟迟没有一个上乘功法作为底牌。
而这个《青霄蕴灵诀》正好作为她的底牌。
林清瑶来到摇椅上盘膝坐下，随后从纳戒中将那枚青色玉简取出。
深吸一口气后，她将心神沉入玉简之中，尝试参悟那部《青霄蕴灵诀》。
一旁收拾完的陆鸣也舒舒服服地躺回自己的摇椅，饶有兴致的看着林清瑶。
他来到这修仙界三年，还是第一次近距离的观看一个修士修炼的样子。
心中也是好奇，这修士修炼到底是什么样子。
只见，林清瑶双眸微闭，睫毛轻轻颤动，神情专注无比。
随着她静心凝神，周身开始有微弱的灵气波动荡漾开来。
而那枚玉简也开始在她掌心散发着淡淡的青色光晕。
啧啧，这就是修炼啊……
看起来还挺像那么回事的。
陆鸣看得津津有味。
content_en:
【bite!
Feed junior sister mutton skewers, and the range will increase by one centimeter!
【bite!
Feed junior sister mutton skewers, and the range will increase by one centimeter!
【bite!
Feed junior sister mutton skewers, and the range will increase by one centimeter!
In the small courtyard.
Every time Lin Qingyao eats a skewer of mutton skewers, the system's voice will sound in Lu Ming's mind.
I have to say that Lin Qingyao is very edible.
The mutton kebabs made by Lu Ming have effects comparable to those of top-grade elixirs.
Lin Qingyao ate with complete abandon, holding a mutton skewer in each hand, her cheeks swelling slightly as she ate, like a hamster.
Lu Ming felt happy when he saw Lin Qingyao eating quickly.
After all, a skewer of mutton can increase the field range by one centimeter.
If possible, she really hoped that Lin Qingyao could eat it non-stop.
The two of them quickly wiped out the mutton skewers, and Lu Ming was able to satisfy his craving. He had eaten enough chicken in the past three years.
In comparison, the mutton skewers are still delicious.
After putting away the bamboo sticks, Lu Ming said to Lin Qingyao: "Okay, we've finished the meal. Junior sister, please hurry up and practice."
"Yes!
Senior brother! "
Lin Qingyao was very motivated, and she also wanted to practice the "Qingxiao Yunling Jue" as soon as possible.
After all, Master Xuanhui had previously said that this technique was an excellent technique and was very powerful.
Although her cultivation level is already at the sixth level of foundation building, she still doesn't have a superior technique as a trump card.
And this "Qingxiao Yunling Jue" happens to be her trump card.
Lin Qingyao came to the rocking chair and sat cross-legged, then took out the blue jade slip from the ring.
After taking a deep breath, she sunk her mind into the jade slips and tried to comprehend the "Qingxiao Yunling Jue".
Lu Ming, who had finished cleaning up on the side, lay back comfortably in his rocking chair and looked at Lin Qingyao with interest.
It has been three years since he came to this world of cultivating immortals, and this is the first time he has seen a monk practicing up close.
I was also curious in my heart about what this monk's cultivation was like.
Lin Qingyao's eyes were slightly closed, her eyelashes were trembling slightly, and her expression was extremely focused.
As she calmed down and concentrated, weak spiritual energy waves began to ripple around her body.
And the jade slip began to emit a faint cyan halo in her palm.
Tsk tsk, this is cultivation...
It seems quite like that.
Lu Ming watched with great interest.
